# The fishing system's texts.
#
# Why this file exists
# --------------------
# Fishing is Vortex's own — reconstructed from Habbo Hotel: Origins, which has no client dump — so
# none of these keys exists in `sources/external_flash_texts.txt` and none ever will. They have to
# come from somewhere the repository tracks: `sources/external_flash_texts.txt` is gitignored, and
# `packages/vortex-client/src/assets/` is regenerated by the asset importer, so an edit in either
# place is invisible to git and lost on the next build.
#
# Apply them to a deployed gamedata file with:
#
#   node build-gamedata-locale.mjs --overrides=locale-overrides/fishing.en.txt \
#        --merge-into=C:/Laragon/www/vortex-assets/gamedata/external_flash_texts.json --write
#
# Merge, never regenerate: the served copy is pruned and hand-edited, and a full regenerate would
# silently drop those edits.
#
# Placeholders
# ------------
# `%name%` placeholders are substituted by `HabboLocalizationManager.registerParameter()`, which the
# views reach through `getLocalizationWithParams(key, default, 'name', value, ...)` — NAME/VALUE
# pairs, not positional values. A caller passing bare values registers the first under the second's
# name and substitutes nothing, which is a mistake this port made once.
#
# Species, zone and rod names are NOT here. Those keys are whatever the operator wrote in the
# `name_key` column of `fishing_species` / `fishing_zones` / `fishing_rod_tiers`, so the defaults
# that the emulator's `Seeds/fishing.sql` seeds are listed at the bottom.

# --- the spot panel -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
vortex.fishing.title=Fishing
vortex.fishing.cast=Start fishing
vortex.fishing.stop=Stop fishing
vortex.fishing.mount=Mount this catch
vortex.fishing.mounted=The trophy is in your inventory.
vortex.fishing.level_required=Requires fishing level %level%
vortex.fishing.no_zone=You cannot fish here.
vortex.fishing.cue.fish=Something is moving in the water...
vortex.fishing.cue.golden=A golden shadow!
vortex.fishing.caught=Caught a %species% — %weight%g
vortex.fishing.depleted=The spot is empty. %catches% caught — find another shadow.

# --- Hook Havoc -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
vortex.fishing.hook_havoc=Hook Havoc! Tap Q and E to keep the line centred.

# The Hook Havoc panel itself — Origins' own `fishingUI` window. Its title sits in the board's red
# plaque and the countdown under the dial.
vortex.fishing.hook_havoc.title=HOOK HAVOC
vortex.fishing.hook_havoc.seconds=%seconds% seconds left
vortex.fishing.hook_havoc.won=Golden %species%! +%amount% fish tokens.
vortex.fishing.hook_havoc.lost=It got away. Fishing continues.

# --- refusals ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The numeric suffix is the FishingErrorCode value. Codes are append-only on both sides, so a code
# this client does not know falls back to `.unknown` rather than showing a bare number.
vortex.fishing.error.0=That is not a fishing spot.
vortex.fishing.error.1=Your fishing level is too low for this spot.
vortex.fishing.error.2=You have earned all the fish tokens you can today.
vortex.fishing.error.3=You are already fishing.
vortex.fishing.error.4=That catch is no longer available.
vortex.fishing.error.5=The derby is not open.
vortex.fishing.error.6=Stand next to the water to fish there.
vortex.fishing.error.unknown=Fishing is not available right now.

# Origins' own Fish-O-Pedia — the book. Its two page headers, its page numbers, and the entry a card

# `detail_days` above are the older panel's, which spells the same axes out in prose.

# The four-bit season mask. How Origins encodes a season is unknown — see fishing.md.

vortex.fishing.season.3=Winter

# The entry page's stat labels: Origins puts the label outside the rounded field and the value in it,
# so these are labels alone (fishpedia_xp_title / _tokens_title / _catch_rate_title in its Lingo).

# The catch bubbles. `hh_fishing.cst` carries no such string — Origins raises these from the main
# client, not from the fishing module — so the keys and the wording are Vortex's own. They go through
# the singular notification bubbles, which are the live half of the notification system.
vortex.fishing.notification.caught=You caught a %species%! (+%xp% XP)
vortex.fishing.notification.golden=A Golden %species%! (+%xp% XP)
vortex.fishing.notification.discovered=New species discovered: %species%! (+%xp% XP)
vortex.fishing.notification.levelup=Fishing level %level%!

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Origins' own window keys, for the six windows scripts/origins/convert-window.py converts.
#
# These are the keys the `.window.txt` elements name in `#key`, so the KEYS are recovered, not
# invented. The wording is not: Origins reads it from its hotel's text table, this hotel serves none
# of it, and no `getText` default in the cast's Lingo covers these. Everything below is therefore
# DERIVED from the key and from what the window's own artwork shows — flagged here rather than
# passed off as recovered.
vortex.fishing.store.tab_info=Info
vortex.fishing.store.tab_store=Store
vortex.fishing.store.tab_stats=Stats
vortex.fishing.store.rod=Fishing rod
vortex.fishing.store.rod_upgrade=Upgrade your rod
vortex.fishing.store.upgrade_button=Upgrade
vortex.fishing.store.stats=Statistics
vortex.fishing.store.storage_title=Fish Storage
vortex.fishing.store.help_title_1=Find a shadow
vortex.fishing.store.help_text_1=Fish shadows appear on the water in fishing rooms. Click one to start.
vortex.fishing.store.help_title_2=Keep fishing
vortex.fishing.store.help_text_2=Your catches keep coming until the spot runs dry. Then find another shadow.
vortex.fishing.store.help_title_3=Hook Havoc
vortex.fishing.store.help_text_3=Tap Q and E to keep the line centred. Win it for a Golden Fish.
